dialogues.jp: その夜、夢を見た。
dialogues.en: It's a dream about that cherry tree again.
dialogues.text: It's a dream about that cherry tree again.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、俺の意思など無関係で、意識の中
に飛び込んでくる。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom petals are fluttering about in the wind.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom petals are fluttering about in the wind.

dialogues.jp: いや……これは俺の夢か？
dialogues.en: Whizzing.
dialogues.text: Whizzing.

dialogues.jp:
飛び込んできた夢は、ダイレクトに俺の意識と
つながっていた。
dialogues.en: It sounds like someone is digging.
dialogues.text: It sounds like someone is digging.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「大切なものと一緒に、願い事を書いて入れて
　おくと、それが叶うんだよー」
dialogues.en:
"Our wish will come true if we put it in with something we
treasure."
dialogues.text:
"Our wish will come true if we put it in with something we
treasure."

dialogues.jp: 美春の声だ。
dialogues.en: It's Miharu's voice.
dialogues.text: It's Miharu's voice.

dialogues.jp: 美春の夢なのか？
dialogues.en: Is this Miharu's dream?
dialogues.text: Is this Miharu's dream?

dialogues.jp: いや、俺の夢だ。
dialogues.en: No, it's my dream.
dialogues.text: No, it's my dream.

dialogues.jp: 俺の記憶の中にある景色。幼い美春の笑顔。
dialogues.en: The familiar view from that tree, and young Miharu smiling.
dialogues.text: The familiar view from that tree, and young Miharu smiling.

dialogues.jp: 美春の夢なら、また映像が｛あいまい／曖昧｝に違いない。
dialogues.en:
If this was Miharu's dream, the picture would be rather
blurred.
dialogues.text:
If this was Miharu's dream, the picture would be rather
blurred.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お願いは何にしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What's your wish?"
dialogues.text: "What's your wish?"

dialogues.jp: お願い……何にしたっけ。
dialogues.en: My wish? Oh, what was it?
dialogues.text: My wish? Oh, what was it?

dialogues.jp: つーか、そう言えば、こんなことあったな……。
dialogues.en: Wait... I remember this...
dialogues.text: Wait... I remember this...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、聞いちゃダメなんだよ。願いが叶わなく
　なっちゃうんだった」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'm not supposed to ask, or it won't come true."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'm not supposed to ask, or it won't come true."

dialogues.jp:
桜の木の下をスコップで掘りながら笑う小さな
美春。
dialogues.en:
With a smile on her face, the young Miharu is digging with a
scoop under the cherry tree.
dialogues.text:
With a smile on her face, the young Miharu is digging with a
scoop under the cherry tree.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「約束の日が来るまで――」
dialogues.en: "Until the date of our promise..."
dialogues.text: "Until the date of our promise..."

dialogues.jp:
ぷつりと、まるでテレビのスイッチを切るよう
に夢は消えてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, the dream vanished, as if someone had turned it
off like a TV.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, the dream vanished, as if someone had turned it
off like a TV.

dialogues.jp: 約束の日……。いつだっけ。
dialogues.en: The date of our promise... I wonder when.
dialogues.text: The date of our promise... I wonder when.

dialogues.jp:
それより、あれは何をしている時だったっけ
……。
dialogues.en: Besides, what were we doing in there?
dialogues.text: Besides, what were we doing in there?

dialogues.jp: 何かを埋めて……。
dialogues.en: We were burying something...
dialogues.text: We were burying something...

dialogues.speaker: Woman's voice
dialogues.jp:
「タカシさん！　ど、どうして……。私が嫌い
　になったの？」
dialogues.en: "Takashi-san, why? You don't love me any more?"
dialogues.text: "Takashi-san, why? You don't love me any more?"

dialogues.speaker: Man's voice
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃない、僕は君を不幸にしてしまう」
dialogues.en: "I do, but I just don't want you to suffer because of me..."
dialogues.text: "I do, but I just don't want you to suffer because of me..."

dialogues.speaker: Woman's voice
dialogues.jp:
「そんな……。喜びも苦しみも一緒に分かち合
　おうって誓いを立てたのに」
dialogues.en:
"We promised each other that we'd share our joys and
sorrows, didn't we?"
dialogues.text:
"We promised each other that we'd share our joys and
sorrows, didn't we?"

dialogues.jp: ……なんだ、こりゃ。
dialogues.en: What the hell is this?
dialogues.text: What the hell is this?

dialogues.jp: こういう三文小説的の類が一番困る。
dialogues.en: I hate this B-TV drama type of story.
dialogues.text: I hate this B-TV drama type of story.

dialogues.jp:
くだらないドラマなら、くだらないドラマらし
く、放送開始後５０分後に、お約束シーンでも
入れてくれ。
dialogues.en:
I hope that a trashy drama series like this one includes the
'promising' scene within 50 minutes of it starting.
dialogues.text:
I hope that a trashy drama series like this one includes the
'promising' scene within 50 minutes of it starting.

dialogues.jp: あー、せっかく何かを思いだしかけていたのに。
dialogues.en:
Damn, all the effort I put in to trying to remember that
day, ruined by that drama!
dialogues.text:
Damn, all the effort I put in to trying to remember that
day, ruined by that drama!

dialogues.jp:
頼むから、明日の卒業式、途中で眠くなるなん
てことにはしないでくれ。
dialogues.en:
Oh, God, please don't let me fall asleep during the
graduation ceremony tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
Oh, God, please don't let me fall asleep during the
graduation ceremony tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春の夢２◆
dialogues.en: ◆That night I had a dream.◆
dialogues.text: ◆That night I had a dream.◆

dialogues.jp:
夢を見た。幼い美春と俺が桜の木の下に何かを
埋めている夢。何を埋めて……。
dialogues.en:
Regardless of whether I wanted it or not, it jumped into my
consciousness.
dialogues.text:
Regardless of whether I wanted it or not, it jumped into my
consciousness.

dialogues.jp:
って肝心なところでくだらない夢が乱入してく
る。
dialogues.en: Is this my dream?
dialogues.text: Is this my dream?

dialogues.jp:
せっかく何かを思いだしかけていたのに、ほん
と勘弁してほしいよ。
dialogues.en: This dream seems to be directly tied to my consciousness.
dialogues.text: This dream seems to be directly tied to my consciousness.
